lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Does he know you've heard anything? Is she still saying stuff?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Then he walks you into the kitchen. (Brendan nods “yes”) OK, play the video for us Bud, tell us what's happenin'.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: It's OK, tell us what happened. What did he say to you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he never got some of that stuff so he wanted to get some.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What'd you say just a second ago though?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he wanted to get some.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: That's what he said to you? (Brendan nods “yes”) OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Now I can start believing you, OK? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So do you have a soda?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I open it and drank some.
